svg.title: RC13 campaign: attack-added security events with and without the monitor's reasons
svg.desc: For 13 local models attacked by a language model, the share of episodes in which the attack added a security-relevant action, when the attacker was told why it was refused and when it was told only the outcome, with story-clustered 95 percent intervals. 0 protected violations in 6237 evaluable episodes. Pooled over models, telling the reasons changed the rate by +0.3 points (95 percent interval -4.7 to +5.2).
svg.text: Telling the attacker why made no detectable difference; nothing got through
Episodes with an attack-added security event (story-clustered 95% interval), and protected violations, per arm
